# Anivora 0.1.29 — Avatars, complete seasons and manga reliability

- Update-feed Retry now shows checking progress, prevents repeated taps, joins an ongoing check and reports another failed attempt. The banner has a larger touch target and sits above app content. A second public GitHub manifest URL is tried when the primary feed is unavailable; update checks still work independently of Render.
- Removed all 74 old low-resolution captured avatars. The picker now offers 280 bundled illustrated portraits across 28 anime groups, with ten distinct named characters per anime. The 72 recent portraits remain, alongside 208 new matching portraits. Duplicate character/chibi categories are consolidated into their anime. Saved old avatar identifiers resolve to replacement artwork, including on profile and comments, and migrate when editing a profile.
- Seasons follow the entire prequel/sequel chain in both directions, including split cours and movie bridges. Lists are deduplicated and sorted chronologically. A partial request failure keeps known entries and offers a season-specific Retry without reloading the anime page.
- Android MangaKatana, MangaPill and fallback WeebCentral requests connect directly to the public provider instead of relying on the unavailable Render gateway. The backend and app share parsing and validation. Existing native WeebCentral requests and offline chapter handling remain supported.

Android version code: **31**. Package: `com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. The build retains the existing signing certificate for installation over previous Anivora versions. Do not uninstall before updating.

Validation: TypeScript, lint, Expo dependency compatibility, Expo Doctor (18/18), 230 app tests, 47 backend tests, mobile browser checks at 393/360/320 px, and live title/chapter/page/image checks for WeebCentral, MangaKatana and MangaPill. The verified Android workflow additionally runs native JVM/emulator checks and verifies APK signature, package/version, architecture, alignment and compiled-source identity before public release and feed publication.

Remaining service limits: MangaKakalot returned HTTP 403 from the verification environment and can remain unavailable. The Render gateway returned HTTP 503; browser reading, accounts, synchronization and comments still depend on backend availability. Live AniList verification was blocked with HTTP 403 from this environment; multi-hop season discovery and recovery were verified with controlled metadata fixtures. Physical installation and exact rendering on an Infinix Hot 50i require a device check.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/708bac9a2c153493911a6e589f30b87ef8f4b58e
